blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Sen. Alan Peter Cayetano accused the Philippine Reclamation Authority (PRA) of “selective justice” in enforcing rules on reclamation projects. He questioned why the PRA issued a cease-and-desist order against a project in Taguig but not the Laguna Lake Shore Road Network (LLRN). “Ongoing now is a massive [Department of Public Works and Highways] project compared with Taguig, which did not submit a feasibility study to you and did not submit an environmental study to you, so you will ignore that? Why?” Cayetano asked PRA Assistant General Manager Joseph John Literal. “No, sir,” Literal said. “No, you’re ignoring it […]...
